text:
Roman Kantserov came over from the KHL, where he scored 36 goals for Metallurg Magnitogorsk last season, and he hasn't stopped. He has 15 goals in 25 NHL games, including his first career hat trick against Vancouver on Nov. 22, and goals in three straight. The Athletic's Mark Lazerus noted he is "scoring at a 47-goal pace now." For a second-round pick, it's a remarkable start: forwards taken around him who stuck averaged 0.30 points a game in their first real season; he's at 0.80.

The finishing is the catch. Fifteen goals on 7.05 expected goals (the quality of his chances) is shooting 33%, and the Blackhawks have scored 6.5 more goals than expected with him on the ice. His chances are rising too, so the hot run is partly earned, and his top skating speed sits in the 96th percentile. A third of his shots going in is still not a rate any shooter holds. Our numbers project 33 goals. Watch the shot volume; that's what carries a scorer once the bounces cool.
headline: Roman Kantserov's rookie scoring run has a finishing catch
